Responsibility map. RLN admission proves membership and committed class credits together; group security sits inside the encrypted payload. Components shown are proposed integrations.

01

Privacy at the endpoints

Event semantics stay encrypted. Receivers recognize relevant events locally rather than exposing subscriptions to relays.

02

Recovery before action

Endpoint recovery is designed to make interrupted workflows recoverable through durable state and bounded replay. External effects still need destination idempotency.

03

Authority is explicit

Encryption and anchor inclusion do not grant permission. Business policy and contract proofs authorize effects.

02 / FOLLOW THE EVENT

From intent to effect.

A proposed message journey. Coordination can finish off-chain; settlement adds a separate proof path.

Five different kinds of evidence

Admission · persistence · anchor/finality · local processing · signed business acknowledgement

These are independent facts. An inclusion proof does not establish delivery, availability or business completion.

03 / RECOVER THE WORKFLOW

Umbra understands Midnight.
Express needs more.

Use UmbraDB and PostgreSQL inside trusted Node backend hosts. Its existing temporal records, checkpoints and cursors give the recovery layer a starting point.

The proposed future release must commit local effects, deduplication, outbox, an optional checkpoint and cursors together, with strict durability, protected restore and writer ownership enforced at commit.

Today: checkpoint + cursorFuture: atomic MPE processing

SQLite serves standalone Rust nodes and clients. The custom MPE store protocol separately handles replicated opaque envelopes and persistence receipts.

04 / PRODUCT PRIORITIES

Ten uses. One shared foundation.

Ranked by confidentiality value, stack reuse, measurable outcomes and dependency burden. Business value remains a hypothesis to validate.

05 / BUILD IN ORDER

Prove coordination.
Then expand the promise.

FIRST PILOT CANDIDATES

RFQ, invoices, agent approvals

Backend and desktop workflows. Signed roles, expiry, recovery and explicit policy. Measure handoffs and turnaround against customer baselines.

PRODUCTION PREREQUISITES

Admission, retention, durability

Real finalized Registry roots, an adapted RLN relation, measured proof limits, replicated storage and funded operators. Validate the proposed Umbra MPE capability or an equivalently verified caller composition.

GATED EXTENSIONS

Groups, ledger effects, mobile

OpenMLS requires identity, epoch and recovery tests. Settlement requires signed authority, atomic replay protection and anchored-message binding; these can be developed alongside coordination. Private mobile reception needs PIR/OMR research.

Deliberate choices

Semaphore: membership lifecycle patterns, not a second publication proof. Signal: retained as a pairwise alternative; OpenMLS is the selected group extension. Kafka, NATS and RabbitMQ: sources of delivery semantics, not required services.

DESIGN & EVIDENCE

Grounded in the design.
Open about the work ahead.

This page presents a recommendation, not a production deployment or a performance claim. No selected library completes the protocol by itself.
